diagram_math_checks.result: Each panel shows exactly five graph vertices: s_{i,j-1}, ell_{i,j}, r_{i,j}, s_{i,j}, c_j, for 1 <= j <= m and m >= 1. This is the consecutive clause-j segment of the crossbar in step 1.1, not a complete gadget. Panel repetitions of c_j represent the same clause vertex in their respective conditional views.

The three drawn double arrows give six arcs: s_prev->ell, ell->s_prev, ell->r, r->ell, r->s_next, s_next->r. All are exactly the bidirected crossbar adjacencies in step 1.1. All three links and both arrowheads per link are visible in native preview tile 02.

Upper extra arcs are ell_{i,j}->c_j and c_j->r_{i,j}, matching step 1.1. Hence the left-to-right route of step 2.1 can replace ell->r by ell->c_j->r when x_i is true. Native arrowheads point into c_j from ell and into r from c_j.

Lower extra arcs are r_{i,j}->c_j and c_j->ell_{i,j}, matching step 1.1. Hence the right-to-left route of step 2.1 can replace r->ell by r->c_j->ell when x_i is false. Native arrowheads point into c_j from r and into ell from c_j.

Each panel contains five graph vertices and eight directed arcs (three double arrows plus two single arrows). In the displayed local subgraph, each separator has in/out degree 1/1 and c_j has 1/1. Positive-panel ell has in/out degree 2/3 and r has 3/2; negative-panel ell has 3/2 and r has 2/3. These are local counts, not full degrees: separators continue outside the panel and other literal occurrences can meet c_j. The caption explicitly preserves these qualifications.

Remarks reproduce exactly p_i->s_{i,0}, p_i->s_{i,m}, s_{i,0}->q_i, s_{i,m}->q_i and q_i=p_{i+1} from step 1.1. If both signs occur, the two conditional detour pairs coexist at the same c_j, as expressly stated by step 1.1. No new boundary edges or cycle closure are drawn; no named-node cycle syntax is used. The existing z_phi->s_phi and t_phi->z_phi closure remains only in unchanged step 3.1.

The original full source is an exact byte prefix of the edited file. Steps 1.1, 2.1, 2.2, 3.1, 4.1 and all hypotheses, dependencies and metadata remain unchanged. Remarks explicitly say the rigorous proof is independent of the illustration.
